card.name: Done without awareness or intent
card.fires_on: The ending of adverbs meaning without awareness, such as instinctively, unconsciously, unwittingly and unknowingly, and the word subconscious. It also fires on the verb right after unknowingly.

modes.label: Unaware-adverb endings
modes.description: The ending of an adverb like unconsciously, unwittingly or instinctively, describing an action done without intent.
modes.example: Instinct<<ively>>, we reach for our umbrellas before

modes.label: Subconscious as a noun
modes.description: The word subconscious used for the mind below awareness.
modes.example: the ukiyo-e influence is deeper in my<< subconscious>> that I gave it credit for.

modes.label: Verb after unknowingly
modes.description: The verb that follows unknowingly in a sentence about unintended actions.
modes.example: or unknowingly<< take>> other acetaminophen-containing products.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings and pieces that finish unaware-type adverbs, though the listed tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on words meaning something was done without realizing it, like unconsciously or unknowingly.
